name: Hard land

v1.prompt: The cat drops from high above and lands hard: the front paws hit, the legs buckle and the body squashes low almost to its belly, ears flatten, tail slaps down; then it pushes back up to standing facing right and gives a small shake. The cat stays centred.  Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The cat stays the same size in every frame.

verdict: good: drops in (5-6), touchdown (7), deep squash (8-14), stands; gives A the in-air touchdown its 07 lacked
suggest: frames 6-14 (squash) at 20 fps; A08 hard land = 4, e.g. 7, 9, 11, 13
